evidence.snippet: before: "Ireland: income while off sick for an employee working Monday to Friday: employer Statutory Sick Leave (5 days a year after 13 weeks' service, 70% of daily pay up to EUR110), Illness Benefit waiting days (SSL days count against the 3 waiting days; start day = max(SSL days, 3) + 1), then Illness Bene" → after: "Ireland: income while off sick for an employee working Monday to Friday: employer Statutory Sick Leave, Illness Benefit waiting days, then Illness Benefit, week by week."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
